english: A flag to activate the adaptive trimming of a multi-layer sandwiched part. Currently setting this to either 0 or 1 will turn on the adaptive trimming. EQ.1: Activate the adaptive trimming.
localized:
用于启用多层夹层部件自适应修整功能的标志。目前将此值设置为 0 或 1 即可激活自适应修整功能。
EQ.1：启用自适应修整功能。

english: Activate scaling flag: EQ.0: Scaling not activated. EQ.1: Scaling activated.
localized:
启用缩放标志：
EQ.0：未启用缩放。
EQ.1：启用缩放。

english: Ambient element type: EQ.4: Pressure inflow/outflow (see Remarks 1 and 2) EQ.5: Receptor for blast load (See *LOAD_BLAST_ENHANCED)
localized:
环境单元类型：
EQ.4：压力流入/流出（参见备注 1 和 2）
EQ.5：爆炸载荷接收器（参见 *LOAD_BLAST_ENHANCED）。

english: Analysis solution procedure: EQ.0: Flow analysis only EQ.1: Combined flow and thermal analysis
localized:
分析求解过程：
EQ.0：仅流动分析
EQ.1：流动与热分析组合。

english: Analysis type for pore water pressure calculations (see Remark 1): EQ.0.0: Tied contacts act as impermeable membranes, EQ.1.0: Fluid may flow freely through tied contacts.
localized: 孔隙水压力计算的分析类型（参见备注 1）：EQ.0.0=绑定接触充当不透水膜；EQ.1.0=流体可自由通过绑定接触。

english: Axial force load curve option: EQ.0: axial load curves are force as a function of strain. EQ.1: axial load curves are force as a function of change in length.
localized:
轴向力载荷曲线选项：
EQ.0：轴向载荷曲线为力随应变变化的函数。
EQ.1：轴向载荷曲线为力随长度变化量变化的函数。

english: Balance thickness changes of the material due to the matrix response when calculating the fiber stresses. Stresses can be scaled to account for the fact that fiber cross-sectional usually does not change. EQ.0: No scaling EQ.1: Scaling
localized:
计算纤维应力时，平衡基体响应导致的材料厚度变化。应力可缩放，以考虑纤维横截面通常不发生变化这一事实。
EQ.0：不缩放。
EQ.1：缩放。

english: Behavior of base material (see Remark 3): EQ.0: Nonlinear using all parameters on Cards 1 through 3 EQ.1: Linear elastic; only the joint planes are nonlinear
localized:
基础材料的行为（见备注 3）：
EQ.0：使用卡片 1 至卡片 3 上的所有参数的非线性行为
EQ.1：线弹性；仅节理面为非线性

english: Bond formulation: EQ.1: (Reserved) EQ.2: Nonlinear heterogeneous bond formulation for fracture analysis based on the general material models defined in the material cards. DES elements with different material models can be defined within one bond.
localized:
黏结算法：
EQ.1：（保留）。
EQ.2：基于材料卡片中定义的通用材料模型，用于断裂分析的非线性非均质黏结算法。同一黏结中可定义采用不同材料模型的 DES 单元。

english: Boundary conditions for global domain x-max: EQ.0: Free EQ.1: Rigid reflecting boundary
localized:
全局域 x-max 的边界条件：
EQ.0：自由。
EQ.1：刚性反射边界。

english: Boundary conditions for global domain x-min: EQ.0: Free EQ.1: Rigid reflecting boundary
localized:
全局域 x-min 的边界条件：
EQ.0：自由。
EQ.1：刚性反射边界。

english: Boundary conditions for global domain y-max: EQ.0: Free EQ.1: Rigid reflecting boundary
localized:
全局域 y-max 的边界条件：
EQ.0：自由。
EQ.1：刚性反射边界。

english: Boundary conditions for global domain y-min: EQ.0: Free EQ.1: Rigid reflecting boundary
localized:
全局域 y-min 的边界条件：
EQ.0：自由。
EQ.1：刚性反射边界。

english: Boundary conditions for global domain z-max: EQ.0: Free EQ.1: Rigid reflecting boundary
localized:
全局域 z-max 的边界条件：
EQ.0：自由。
EQ.1：刚性反射边界。

english: Boundary conditions for global domain z-min: EQ.0: Free EQ.1: Rigid reflecting boundary
localized:
全局域 z-min 的边界条件：
EQ.0：自由。
EQ.1：刚性反射边界。

english: Boundary layer mesh thickness if BLST = 1 or 2. Growth scale factor if BLST = 3. Ignored if BLST = 0. See Remark 5.
localized: BLST = 1 或 2 时的边界层网格厚度；BLST = 3 时的增长比例因子；BLST = 0 时忽略。参见备注 5。

english: Calculate the nodal displacements and velocities of *MAT_ACOUSTIC volume elements for inclusion in d3plot and time-history files. EQ.0: Acoustic nodal motions will not be calculated EQ.1: Acoustic nodal motions will be calculated
localized:
计算 *MAT_ACOUSTIC 体单元的节点位移和速度，以便写入 d3plot 和时程文件。
EQ.0：不计算声学节点运动。
EQ.1：计算声学节点运动。

english: Calculation option: EQ.0: view factors
localized:
计算选项：
EQ.0：视因子。

english: Cap retraction option: EQ.0: Cap does not retract (default). EQ.1: Cap retracts.
localized:
帽盖面回缩选项：
EQ.0：帽盖面不回缩（默认值）。
EQ.1：帽盖面回缩。

english: Compressive displacement at failure. Input as a positive number. After failure, no forces are carried. This option does not apply to zero length springs. EQ.0.0: inactive.
localized:
失效时的压缩位移。输入正数。失效后不承受任何力。此选项不适用于零长度弹簧。
EQ.0.0：未激活。

english: Compute the average number of neighbors: EQ.0: Using all SPH parts for which this condition applies. In other words, the average is computed using all the SPH parts specified in ID. EQ.1: Per SPH part. In other words, each SPH part has its own average value.
localized:
平均邻近粒子数的计算方式：
EQ.0：使用适用该条件的所有 SPH 部件，即使用 ID 指定的所有 SPH 部件计算平均值。
EQ.1：按 SPH 部件分别计算，即每个 SPH 部件都有自己的平均值。

english: Constant B in the flow stress. See equations in Remark 1. This field is ignored if A < 0.0.
localized: 流动应力中的常数 B。参见备注 1 中的方程；当 A < 0.0 时忽略此字段。

english: Constant n in the flow stress. See equations in Remark 1. This field is ignored if A < 0.0.
localized: 流动应力中的常数 n。参见备注 1 中的方程；当 A < 0.0 时忽略此字段。

english: Control option: EQ.0: calculate view factors matrix and preform thermal analysis
localized:
控制选项：
EQ.0：计算视因子矩阵并执行热分析。

english: Convection heat transfer coefficient, h. Ignored if HLCID > 0.
localized: 对流传热系数 h。当 HLCID > 0 时忽略。

english: Coordinates used in rebalance: EQ.0: Current coordinates NE.0: Coordinates at t = 0
localized:
再平衡中使用的坐标：
EQ.0：当前坐标。
NE.0：t = 0 时的坐标。

english: Coupling to the heat equation when EM quantities are solved on fluid elements. When turned on, the EM solver will transfer the Joule heating terms to the ICFD solver. EQ.0: Coupling off. EQ.1: Coupling on.
localized:
流体单元求解电磁量时与热方程的耦合：
EQ.0：关闭耦合。
EQ.1：开启耦合，电磁求解器将焦耳热项传递给 ICFD 求解器。

english: Critical Cockcroft-Latham damage value (include if ADPDAM = 2)
localized: 临界 Cockcroft-Latham 损伤值（ADPDAM = 2 时填写）。

english: CSP solver option: EQ.0: Do not use the CSP solver, and ignore the AMPL and YCUT parameters (default). GT.0: Use the CSP solver, with the AMPL and YCUT parameters.
localized:
CSP 求解器选项：
EQ.0：不使用 CSP 求解器，忽略 AMPL 和 YCUT 参数（默认值）。
GT.0：使用 CSP 求解器，并应用 AMPL 和 YCUT 参数。

english: Curve ID for the rotational velocity: GT.0: Load curve ID; see *DEFINE_CURVE. LT.0: -LCVR is the function ID for the rotational velocity which depends on 5 arguments: time, number of cycles, and nodal coordinates. See *DEFINE_FUNCTION. See Remark 5.
localized:
旋转速度的曲线 ID：
GT.0：载荷曲线 ID，参见 *DEFINE_CURVE。
LT.0：-LCVR 为定义旋转速度的函数 ID，该函数依赖 5 个参数：时间、循环次数和节点坐标。参见 *DEFINE_FUNCTION 和备注 5。

english: Cylinder or sphere radius if DRTYP = 3 or 4, respectively
localized: 当 DRTYP = 3 或 4 时，分别为圆柱或球体半径。

english: Define CLP1 moving direction: GT.0: Vector ID from *DEFINE_VECTOR, specifying the moving direction of CLP1 LT.0: Absolute value is a node ID, whose normal vector will be used to define the moving direction of CLP1.
localized:
定义 CLP1 的移动方向：
GT.0：*DEFINE_VECTOR 中指定移动方向的向量 ID。
LT.0：绝对值为节点 ID；该节点的法向量用于定义 CLP1 的移动方向。

english: Defines the initialization type: EQ.1: Give initial pressure and temperature.
localized:
定义初始化类型：
EQ.1：给定初始压力和温度。

english: DES part type: EQ.0: Part set ID, EQ.1: Part ID.
localized:
DES 部件类型：
EQ.0：部件集 ID，
EQ.1：部件 ID。

english: Determines if LS-DYNA creates the output file: EQ.0: Do not generate the output file. EQ.1: Generate the output file.
localized:
确定 LS-DYNA 是否创建输出文件：
EQ.0：不生成输出文件
EQ.1：生成输出文件。

english: Determines if the output file should be dumped. EQ.0: No output file is generated. EQ.1: The output file is generated.
localized:
确定是否生成输出文件。
EQ.0：不生成输出文件。
EQ.1：生成输出文件。

english: Determines if the solver should calculate the uniformity index. EQ.0: Off. EQ.1: On.
localized:
决定求解器是否需计算均匀性指数。
EQ.0：关闭。
EQ.1：开启。

english: Discrete beam flag. If CON = 0 and displacement boundary conditions are applied to nodes specified in NSID, then this flag must be set to 1. When DBFLG = 1, discrete beam elements are created to connect nodes in NSID to the patch.
localized:
离散梁标志。若 CON = 0 且对 NSID 中的节点施加位移边界条件，则必须将此标志设为 1。
DBFLG = 1 时，创建离散梁单元，将 NSID 中的节点连接到 NURBS 曲面片。

english: Elastic flag: EQ.0: The layer is viscoelastic. EQ.1: The layer is elastic.
localized:
弹性标志：
EQ.0：该层为黏弹性。
EQ.1：该层为弹性。

english: ELEM type: EQ.1: Solid EQ.2: Beam EQ.3: Shell EQ.4: Tshell
localized:
ELEM 类型：
EQ.1：实体单元。
EQ.2：梁单元。
EQ.3：壳单元。
EQ.4：厚壳单元（Tshell）。

english: Element energy update method (see Remark 6): EQ.0: Ideal gas gamma law EQ.1: Pressure work
localized:
单元能量更新方法（参见备注 6）：
EQ.0：理想气体 γ 定律。
EQ.1：压力功。

english: Environment temperature, T_infinity. Ignored if TLCID > 0.
localized: 环境温度 T_infinity。TLCID > 0 时忽略。

english: Equation of state flag: EQ.0: Off EQ.1: On
localized:
状态方程标志：
EQ.0：关闭。
EQ.1：开启。

english: File format to use: EQ.1: Use old binary file format EQ.2: Use new LSDA file format
localized:
要使用的文件格式：
EQ.1：使用旧的二进制文件格式。
EQ.2：使用新的 LSDA 文件格式。

english: Flag determining whether to compute the torque in the direction that is the cross product of the drag and lift directions: EQ.0: Do not compute the torque. NE.0: Compute the torque.
localized:
用于确定是否计算沿阻力方向与升力方向叉积方向的力矩的标志：
EQ.0： 不计算力矩。
NE.0： 计算力矩。

english: Flag for behavior in case of unwanted interpolation/extrapolation of initial stresses from *INITIAL_STRESS_SHELL. EQ.0: Only warning is written, calculation continues (default). EQ.1: Error exit, calculation stops.
localized:
用于在 *INITIAL_STRESS_SHELL 中的初始应力发生不希望出现的插值/外推行为时所使用的标志。
EQ.0：仅输出警告，计算继续进行（默认值）。
EQ.1：因错误而终止，计算停止。

english: Flag for binary output: EQ.0: Do not write the file. EQ.1: Write data to an ASCII file. EQ.2: Write data to binary database binout. EQ.3: Write data to an ASCII file and to binary database binout.
localized:
二进制输出标志：
EQ.0：不写入文件。
EQ.1：将数据写入 ASCII 文件。
EQ.2：将数据写入二进制数据库 binout。
EQ.3：将数据同时写入 ASCII 文件和二进制数据库 binout。

english: Flag for computational welding mechanics input. One additional input card is read. EQ.1.0: Active EQ.0.0: Inactive
localized:
用于计算焊接力学输入的标志。将会读取一张额外的输入卡片。
EQ.1.0：启用。
EQ.0.0：禁用。

english: Flag for flow treatment of fluid elements in the gap: EQ.0: Element exclusion contact treatment EQ.1: Porous media description
localized:
间隙中流体单元流动处理标志：
EQ.0：单元排除接触处理。
EQ.1：多孔介质描述。

english: Flag for optional crack tracking algorithm (see Remark 10): EQ.0.0: Inactive EQ.1.0: Active
localized:
可选裂纹跟踪算法的标志（见备注 10）：
EQ.0.0：未激活。
EQ.1.0：激活。

english: Flag for outputting the generated S-ALE mesh (see Remark 3): EQ.0: Do not output the S-ALE mesh. EQ.1: Output the S-ALE mesh into a file named salemsh.inc.
localized:
输出生成的 S-ALE 网格（参见备注 3）的标志：
EQ.0：不输出 S-ALE 网格。
EQ.1：将 S-ALE 网格输出到名为 salemsh.inc 的文件。

english: Flag for reference geometry in acoustic eigenvalue analysis: EQ.0: use original geometry (t = 0), EQ.1: use deformed geometry at the end of transient analysis.
localized:
声学特征值分析中的参考几何体标志：
EQ.0：使用原始几何体（t = 0）。
EQ.1：使用瞬态分析结束时的变形几何体。

english: Flag for strong objectivity (frame invariance) in non-groupable single surface contacts with SOFT = 0 or 1. Strong objectivity incurs an extra cost but may improve results. EQ.0: Do not turn on strong objectivity. EQ.1: Turn on strong objectivity.
localized:
SOFT = 0 或 1 时，不可分组单面接触的强客观性（参考系不变性）标志。强客观性会增加计算开销，但可能改善结果。
EQ.0：不启用强客观性。
EQ.1：启用强客观性。

english: Flag for switching between formulations 16 and 30: EQ.0: Do not convert the shell formulations. EQ.1: Convert all formulation 16 shells to 30. EQ.2: Convert all formulation 30 shells to 16.
localized:
壳单元公式 16 与 30 的转换标志：
EQ.0：不转换壳单元公式。
EQ.1：将所有采用公式 16 的壳单元转换为公式 30。
EQ.2：将所有采用公式 30 的壳单元转换为公式 16。

english: Flag for the binary file: EQ.3: Data is written to the binary file binout.
localized:
二进制文件标志：
EQ.3：数据写入二进制文件 binout。

english: Flag for the type of system on which the boundary condition is applied (applies only for cardiac electrophysiology when *EM_BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED is used with EMSOL = 11 or 12): EQ.0: Applied on extracellular potential EQ.1: Applied on transmembrane potential
localized:
施加边界条件的系统类型标志（仅适用于心脏电生理：使用 *EM_BOUNDARY_PRESCRIBED 且 EMSOL = 11 或 12）：
EQ.0：施加于细胞外电势。
EQ.1：施加于跨膜电势。

english: Flag for the units of the phase angle: EQ.0: Degrees EQ.1: Radians
localized:
相位角单位标志：
EQ.0：度。
EQ.1：弧度。

english: Flag for where to output the S-ALE part data (see Remarks 1 and 2): EQ.0: Output S-ALE part data to d3plot. EQ.1: Write S-ALE part data to binary, LSDA-format database d3sale.
localized:
S-ALE 部件数据的输出位置标志（参见备注 1 和 2）：
EQ.0：输出到 d3plot
EQ.1：写入二进制 LSDA 格式数据库 d3sale。

english: Flag to activate the computation of depolarization: EQ.0: Off EQ.1: On
localized:
启用去极化计算的标志：
EQ.0：关闭。
EQ.1：开启。

english: Flag to activate the computation of repolarization times: EQ.0: Off EQ.1: On
localized:
启用复极化时间计算的标志：
EQ.0：关闭。
EQ.1：开启。

english: Flag to align the dynamics of plane strain and axisymmetric beams in 2D FSI ALE models to their shell counterparts in 3D FSI ALE models: EQ.0.0: Off (default) EQ.1.0: On
localized: 使 2D FSI ALE 模型中平面应变/轴对称梁的动力学与 3D FSI ALE 模型对应壳单元对齐的标志：EQ.0.0=关闭（默认）；EQ.1.0=开启。

english: Flag to delete or activate rigid walls: EQ.0: no change, EQ.1: delete, EQ.2: activate.
localized:
用于标记是删除还是激活刚性墙的参数：
EQ.0：无变化，
EQ.1：删除，
EQ.2：激活。

english: Flag to enable computing the fluid forces and generating output: EQ.0: No output is generated. EQ.1: Output is generated.
localized:
启用流体力计算并生成输出的标志：
EQ.0：不生成输出
EQ.1：生成输出。

english: Flag to input further data. If EXTRA > 0, then Card 4 is read.
localized: 用于输入更多数据的标志。若 EXTRA > 0，则读取第 4 张卡片。

english: Flag to output a high-resolution plot state format: EQ.0: Not output EQ.4: Ensight binary
localized:
输出高分辨率绘图状态格式的标志：
EQ.0：不输出
EQ.4：Ensight 二进制格式。

english: Flag to output material curing into d3ispg: LE.0: No GT.0: Yes
localized:
将材料固化状态输出到 d3ispg 的标志：
LE.0：否。
GT.0：是。

english: Flag to output shear strain rates into d3ispg (see Remark 2): LE.0: No GT.0: Yes
localized:
将剪切应变率输出到 d3ispg 的标志（参见备注 2）：
LE.0：否。
GT.0：是。

english: Flag to output stresses into d3ispg (see Remark 1): LE.0: No GT.0: Yes
localized:
将应力输出到 d3ispg 的标志（参见备注 1）：
LE.0：否。
GT.0：是。

english: Flag to output temperature into d3ispg: LE.0: No GT.0: Yes
localized:
将温度输出到 d3ispg 的标志：
LE.0：否。
GT.0：是。

english: Flag to output viscosity into d3ispg: LE.0: No GT.0: Yes
localized:
将黏度输出到 d3ispg 的标志：
LE.0：否。
GT.0：是。

english: Flag to turn on an unfolding simulation: EQ.1: Activate the unfolding simulation program.
localized:
用于启用展开模拟的标志：
EQ.1：激活展开模拟程序。

english: Flag to use reference geometry specified with *INITIAL_FOAM_REFERENCE_GEOMETRY to initialize the stress tensor. EQ.0.0: Off EQ.1.0: On
localized: 使用 *INITIAL_FOAM_REFERENCE_GEOMETRY 指定的参考几何初始化应力张量的标志：EQ.0.0=关闭；EQ.1.0=开启。

english: Format: EQ.0: Standard format NE.0: Extended precision format
localized:
格式：
EQ.0：标准格式。
NE.0：扩展精度格式。

english: Formulation for rate effects: EQ.0.0: Scale yield stress (default) EQ.1.0: Viscoplastic formulation
localized:
速率效应算法：
EQ.0.0：缩放屈服应力（默认值）。
EQ.1.0：黏塑性算法。

english: Gravity force direction. EQ.1: Global x direction EQ.2: Global y direction EQ.3: Global z direction
localized:
重力方向：
EQ.1：全局 x 方向。
EQ.2：全局 y 方向。
EQ.3：全局 z 方向。

english: ID of a node located in the local xy-plane if DIR = X, the local yz-plane if DIR = Y, and the local zx-plane if DIR = Z.
localized: 当 DIR = X 时位于局部 xy 平面的节点 ID；当 DIR = Y 时位于局部 yz 平面的节点 ID；当 DIR = Z 时位于局部 zx 平面的节点 ID。

english: ID of a point giving the maximum coordinate of the box if ISHAPE = 1 or the head point of the cylinder if ISHAPE = 2.
localized: 点的 ID，用于给出 ISHAPE = 1 时盒体的最大坐标，或 ISHAPE = 2 时圆柱体的端点。

english: ID type of set SIDA: EQ.0: Segment set EQ.1: Shell element set EQ.2: Part set
localized:
集合 SIDA 的 ID 类型：
EQ.0：段集。
EQ.1：壳单元集。
EQ.2：部件集。

english: ID type of set SIDB: EQ.0: Segment set EQ.1: Shell element set EQ.2: Part set
localized:
集合 SIDB 的 ID 类型：
EQ.0：段集。
EQ.1：壳单元集。
EQ.2：部件集。

english: ID type of SID: EQ.0: segment set ID, EQ.1: shell element set ID, EQ.2: part set ID, EQ.3: part ID, EQ.4: node set ID.
localized:
SID 的 ID 类型：
EQ.0：段集 ID
EQ.1：壳单元集 ID
EQ.2：部件集 ID
EQ.3：部件 ID
EQ.4：节点集 ID。

english: If TDR is greater than 0 the bag with ID = CPMID will be rigid starting at first cycle and switch to deformable at time TDR.
localized: 若 TDR > 0，则 ID = CPMID 的气囊从第一个循环开始为刚体，并在时间 TDR 转为可变形状态。

english: Indicates the coupling direction to the solver: EQ.1: The solid mechanics solver transfers displacements to the fluid solver. EQ.2: The fluid solver transfers stresses to the solid mechanics solver.
localized:
指示与求解器的耦合方向：
EQ.1：固体力学求解器将位移传递给流体求解器。
EQ.2：流体求解器将应力传递给固体力学求解器。

english: Initial thickness: GT.0.0: Cohesive thickness. LE.0.0: Initial thickness is calculated from nodal coordinates.
localized:
